title: CORE-7279 · [RF] /privacy-policy/ — clause lettering broken throughout numbered content (phantom wrapper rows; nested marker type & spacing)
body:
Linear: https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7279/rf-privacy-policy-clause-lettering-broken-throughout-numbered-content

(Reference only — the ticket is the source of truth; fetch the live description at implement time.)

Imported by Planning 2026-09-04 as part of the board↔Linear sync: this ticket was open and assigned at Todo in Linear but had no row on the board.
acceptanceCriteria: Section 8 'How we collect your personal data' renders as a single 5-clause list lettered a.-e. (not split into 3 lists restarting at 'a.').
Section 19 'Your Rights' clauses after the nested sub-list read d./e./f. (not e./f./g., not shifted by the phantom wrapper).
No content-less/phantom <li> rows remain anywhere in the /privacy-policy/ article content — total <li> count matches live (187), not the clone's current 200.
Both nested sub-lists on the page (e.g. 'From third parties' under Section 8) render lower-roman markers (i.-x.), not lower-alpha.
Nested-list item pitch matches live (30px between items, no added ~10px gap) — item height itself already matches at 30px.
No regression to top-level lower-alpha lists elsewhere on the page that already match live.
Verified at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800 — breakpoint-invariant markup-level fix, confirmed working at all four.
